---
title: "Applied Time Series Econometrics"
---

Self-study materials for the Applied Time Series Econometrics course at
Universidad Carlos III de Madrid.

## Course materials

- **[Chapters](chapters/index.qmd)**: self-study handouts, in HTML and PDF.
- **Slides**: the lecture decks.
- **Labs**: hands-on sessions in R (Quarto) and Python (Google Colab).
- **Capstone projects**: applied research projects.
- **[Resources](resources/index.qmd)**: the course's Python and R packages and web apps.
- **[Setup](setup/index.qmd)**: getting R, Python and the FRED API key working.
